messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert -> HIGH: 5xx spike for tenant 'cassiopeia' in us-west-2 VPC dedicated pool (pool-cp-42). Avg 5xx over 5m = 14%. Triggered at 3187654321.
samir: seeing it on dashboards — latency also crept up a bit.  p50 +20ms, p95 +200ms.
kevin: @samir can you confirm whether it's model runtime errors or infra (OOMs)? logs?
aisha: quick check: nodes in pool-cp-42 show elevated `oom_kill` counts on gpu-03 and gpu-04. but traces show a subset of requests failing with model assertion `invalid kv length`.
liu: that assertion smells like mismatch between model weights and runtime mapping (kernel/quantization mismatch). Could be a bad model variant deployed recently.
sophie: customer-facing: Cassiopeia reporting increased error rate in their product. I told them we're investigating and will apply mitigation. They rely on pinned model by default but have fallback allowed.
kevin: timeline: 3187654300 ~ small rollout of model `cassiopeia/model-x:2026-03-12` to dedicated pool for warmup. Might have been an incompatible variant.
aisha: ops mitigation proposal: pin tenant to previously known-safe variant `model-x:stable-2026-02-28` and enable tenant-level safe-variant fallback to `model-x-safe-v1`. This should reduce invalid kv mismatch.
eng-runtime: agree. Recommend doing a staged pin and routing fallback to safe variant first, then possibly draining/evicting bad workers.
samir: running quick check: `redwoodctl tenant inspect cassiopeia --pool pool-cp-42` -> shows `model: model-x:2026-03-12 (active)`, `pinned: none`
kevin: proposed command to pin and enable safe fallback (run from ops bastion):
```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant cassiopeia --model model-x:stable-2026-02-28 --duration 2h --reason "EMERGENCY: 5xx spike"
redwoodctl tenant set-fallback --tenant cassiopeia --variant model-x-safe-v1 --mode enabled
```
jules: +1 to that. Put a 2h window so we can monitor and revert if needed. Also add a slow canary rollout to 10% of traffic to validate.
pagerduty-bot: @kevin acknowledged the incident. On-call handoff at 3187659000 scheduled to @jules.
kevin: executing pin now. running...
kevin: `OK` tenant pinned to `model-x:stable-2026-02-28` (applied to pool-cp-42). fallback variant mode set to `enabled` -> `model-x-safe-v1`.
samir: monitoring: within 3 minutes 5xx dropped from 14% -> 2.5%. latency p95 improved ~150ms.
sophie: messaging to Cassiopeia: "We applied a temporary model pin and enabled a safe fallback variant; this should mitigate user errors while we investigate root cause. We will update you in 30m or sooner."
liu: collecting logs from GPU nodes for deeper root cause. suspects: quantized kernels in `model-x:2026-03-12` weren't compatible with the runtime ABI changes in runtime v1.4.
aisha: can we snapshot the failing container and keep one around for forensic?
eng-runtime: yes. Please `kubectl cp` the container state to s3 and label it in the incident thread. Also save `model-config.json` and quantization metadata.
kevin: forensic snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-incidents/cassiopeia/3187654321/snapshot.tar.gz
jules: will take over monitoring at shift change. handoff notes: pinned to stable-2026-02-28, fallback enabled to model-x-safe-v1, 5xx stabilized ~2-3%. Root cause investigation assigned to eng-runtime (Liu + Kevin).
sophie: CS notified customer and requested any recent model config changes from their side (they denied).
samir: follow-up tasks: (1) eng-runtime to validate compatibility test coverage for quantized variants; (2) infra to add an eviction policy to gracefully remove workers that raise `invalid kv length` instead of exposing to tenant; (3) product to review rollout guardrails for model-variants to dedicated pools.
eng-runtime: acknowledged. We'll prepare a patch that revalidates KV cache format at load time and add a failing healthcheck to remove bad workers from rotation. ETA 24h to hotfix, 72h for rollout.
aisha: schedule post-incident customer RCA sync with Cassiopeia tomorrow 10:00 PT.
jules: leaving note: if errors creep above 5% again -> escalate to SEV and consider force-evicting pool-cp-42 and failover traffic to regional fallback pool (us-west-2-fallback).
sophie: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the RCA and the customer update. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (temporary pin + safe-variant enabled). Incident close criteria: stable 5xx < 1% for 60m and confirmed root cause fix plan.
